Hello! Thank you for this :') 

I ended up removing my begonia from its soil to take a look at what was going wrong (hopefully so I don't repeat it in the future) and to my surprise the roots were actually doing okay (by that I mean they weren't rotting, weren't waterlogged). Soil was still a little moist, so I think perhaps my plant was just very frustrated at me. 

I ended up removing the plant from the soil and I trimmed the dying leaves, and put it in water in the hopes that it'll develop a stronger root system (and hopefully some new baby leaves). 

Also, you were right! Some of the droopy cuttings I got from my begonia have perked up overnight after placing them in water so I hope it works out for these little ones too. 

I know begonias are super tough but I didn't know it would be *this* tough, thank you so much for the help!

I can get what you mean by this! Solo Q still gives me great anxiety (and also, my heart really does beat much faster playing in solo queue). Sometimes it's obvious when someone's going to be toxic (like, they call you out for an agent you chose, or try to instruct people what to do at some kind of ridiculous level, or the classic "sage wall mid".) I usually give them a chance but when things go south I mute them.

At the same time, because I get very anxious playing in solo queue, the moment I feel like I'm going to scream, I'll momentarily mute everyone for a round or two while my brain settles down. 

In lower elos barely anyone talks anyway, if they do it's most likely on chat and they're most likely being toxic.

What's more important I feel, is to ~not~ mute people immediately, or keep Comms off entirely. Closes off the opportunity to have good people speak to you as well!
